The framework behind every post

Learned by growing my own page
1 · Hook

The first 2 seconds or the first line decides if anyone stays. I test a few hooks per idea and keep what holds attention.

2 · Value

Every post teaches, entertains or proves something. If it doesn’t do one of the three, it doesn’t go out.

3 · Action

One clear next step: save, share, comment a keyword, or tap the link. Saves and shares bring new people in.

Booking flow I’d set up

  1. Every post ends with one action: “Message us SLOT to book.”
  2. Saved replies answer prices, areas and available times in seconds.
  3. Stories on Monday show the week’s open slots.
  4. After each groom, a friendly message asks for a review and a photo.

Formats

Grids, carousels and stories

Instagram layout & thought process

Harbor Home Realty (concept) · numbers show the posting order
harborhome.realtyHomes by the bay · Book a viewing ↓
7JUST
8SOLD
9🔑 Thank you!
4
53 things to check before you sign a lease
6Meet Ana, your local agent
1Buying your first home? Start here →
2
3Open house · Sat 10–2
  1. Lead with help, not listings. The first post is a beginner’s guide, so new followers see the agency as a helpful local expert.
  2. Alternate three tones. Navy, sky blue and sand tiles rotate, so the grid looks calm and planned from any scroll position.
  3. Mix the content types. Every row has a listing, a tip and a person, so the page shows properties, expertise and the faces behind it.
  4. Celebrate wins as a set. “Just sold” runs across three posts as one banner, which stands out on the profile.
  5. Always a next step. Captions end with a clear action: book a viewing, save the tip or DM a question.

Carousel sample

My own content · swipe or use the arrows
@owljoules

3 hooks that stopped 9M+ scrollers

What I learned growing to 47K followers →

Hook 1

Break the pattern

Open on a movement, sound or visual nobody expects in the first second.

“Wait… is that a bow made of light?”
Hook 2

Open a loop

Promise an answer the viewer only gets by watching to the end.

“By the last clip you’ll know why I almost quit.”
Hook 3

Speak to one person

A POV line makes the right viewer feel seen instantly.

“POV: you finally finished the cosplay at 3 AM.”
Save this

Test one hook per post for a week.

Keep the one with the best 3-second hold rate, then make five variations of it.

Why it works

The cover promises a specific payoff with a number. Each middle slide teaches one idea with a real example, and the last slide gives an action worth saving. Saves and shares are what push a carousel to new people.

Community management

Replies that turn followers into customers

Sample replies in each brand’s voice. Fast, friendly, and always with a next step.

Kalma Café · Instagram comment

@mika.studiesis the ube latte available on weekdays? 🥺
kalma.cafeWeekends only for now, Mika 💜 but our Ube Cookie is on the menu every day! Want us to save you a latte on Saturday?

Why: answers fast, offers an alternative, and invites a visit.

Suds & Paws · Messenger

CustomerHi, how much for a shih tzu? Do you go to Pasig?
Suds & PawsHi! Yes, we cover Pasig 🐾 Full grooming for a small breed starts at ₱850. We have Thursday 2 PM or Saturday 10 AM open. Which works for you?

Why: gives the price, confirms the area and offers two times, so booking is one reply away.

Lumen Skin · Unhappy comment

@jasmine.rmy order is 5 days late and nobody answers 😤
lumen.skinWe’re so sorry, Jasmine. That’s not the experience we want for you. We just sent you a DM so we can check your order number and fix this today.

Why: apologizes in public, moves details to private, and promises a timeline.

Coral Fit · TikTok comment

@ren_triesDAY 1 done but my arms are shaking lol
coral.fitThat’s the work paying off, Ren! 💪 Shaky arms on Day 1 means you showed up. See you tomorrow for Day 2 👀

Why: celebrates the member and pulls them back tomorrow.

What worked

  • POV hooks kept people watching longer than product-first openings.
  • Customer features got the most saves and new tags.

Next month we’ll test

  1. Two more limited drinks with the same weekend-only format
  2. A weekday “study hours” promo in stories
  3. Posting reels at 7 PM instead of noon
